services.title: Solar, simplified. Power your home with daylight.
services.standfirst: Generate more of your own electricity, reduce your exposure to rising energy costs and add a dependable, low-maintenance asset to your home.

heroImage.alt: Black solar panels on a pitched slate roof

services.intro: Panels sized to how your household actually uses power and laid out to sit cleanly with the architecture of your home.

benefits.title: Lower electricity bills
benefits.text: Every unit you generate is one you don't buy. How much you save depends on system size and usage — and surplus can be sold back to the grid.

benefits.title: Low maintenance
benefits.text: Panels need little more than an occasional clean. Reputable manufacturers back them with 20–25 year warranties.

benefits.title: Cleaner energy
benefits.text: Daylight is abundant and renewable, so your home relies less on fossil fuels and carries a smaller carbon footprint.

benefits.title: Added property value
benefits.text: Homes with solar are increasingly sought after — a sustainable upgrade that is also a sound long-term investment.

feature.title: A system that fits the property, not a package
feature.text: We take your consumption, roof layout and budget into account to create a plan that maximises output and savings — and we tell you plainly if your roof isn't right for it.

image.alt: Engineers fitting solar panels on a slate roof

process.title: Book a consultation
process.text: Tell us about your property, energy use and priorities. We answer your questions and establish the right starting point, with no obligation.

process.title: Bespoke solar design
process.text: Our experts design a tailored system around your energy use, roof layout and budget, optimised for efficiency and savings.

process.title: Professional installation
process.text: Our accredited team manages installation safely and efficiently, with careful workmanship and minimal disruption to your day.

process.title: Energy independence
process.text: Once your system is live we help you understand its performance, and stay available for monitoring, maintenance and aftercare.

services.title: Keep the power you generate.
services.standfirst: Store surplus solar by day and use it through the evening, or charge on cheaper overnight tariffs — so more of your energy comes from you.

heroImage.alt: Solar panel array on a slate roof

services.intro: A home battery holds on to the electricity your panels make at midday, so it is still working for you after dark.

benefits.title: Use more of your own solar
benefits.text: Instead of exporting surplus at a low rate, you store it and use it when you need it most.

benefits.title: Cheaper off-peak charging
benefits.text: Charge the battery overnight on a time-of-use tariff and run the house from it at peak times.

benefits.title: Backup when the grid drops
benefits.text: Systems with backup capability keep essential circuits running through a power cut.

benefits.title: Ready for what comes next
benefits.text: Storage pairs naturally with heat pumps and EV charging as your home moves away from fossil fuels.

feature.title: The right capacity, not the biggest box
feature.text: We look at your generation, consumption and tariff to size a battery that pays its way — and tell you plainly if storage isn't worth it yet.

services.title: Feel the comfort, see the savings.
services.standfirst: Air source heat pumps draw heat from the outside air — even when it's cold — and use it to warm your home and your hot water.

heroImage.alt: Heat pump outside a home on a frosty morning

services.intro: We design, install and maintain heat pump systems as a lower-carbon alternative to oil and gas, with emitters sized room by room so the house is actually warm.

benefits.title: Energy efficiency
benefits.text: A heat pump delivers more heat energy than the electricity it uses, which means significantly lower running costs than a traditional boiler or electric heater.

benefits.title: Lower carbon
benefits.text: As a renewable technology, a heat pump cuts your home's carbon footprint from the day it's switched on.

benefits.title: Heating and hot water
benefits.text: One system covers space heating and hot water, with minimal ongoing maintenance.

benefits.title: Grants and incentives
benefits.text: In Scotland, government grants and loans can reduce the upfront cost. We help you find the options that apply to you.

feature.title: Placed for performance, and quiet
feature.text: We work with you on the best location for the outdoor unit for efficient operation and minimal noise, and check your property is suitable before anything is ordered. After installation, our team stays on hand for guidance and maintenance.

image.alt: Heat pump unit mounted beside a rendered wall

applications.title: Retrofit
applications.text: Heat pumps integrate with existing radiators or underfloor heating, upgrading older homes without invasive work.

applications.title: New build
applications.text: Planned from the ground up, with optimal placement and modern insulation to maximise performance.

applications.title: Commercial
applications.text: Scalable, controllable heating and cooling for offices through to large industrial spaces.

services.title: Charging that fits your journey.
services.standfirst: Whether you drive an EV, run a business fleet or are developing new homes, we design and install reliable charging that is simple to use from day one.

heroImage.alt: Home EV charger on a driveway with a parked electric car

services.intro: We coordinate capacity, charger placement, installation and handover, with smart options to schedule charging onto your cheapest hours.

benefits.title: Home charging
benefits.text: Garage, driveway or wherever suits. We check your electrical system for compatibility and safety first.

benefits.title: Business and fleet
benefits.text: From a couple of points to a full network for staff, customers and fleets — designed to meet local regulations.

benefits.title: Reliable equipment
benefits.text: Chargers from trusted manufacturers, with app-based monitoring and smart scheduling.

benefits.title: Grants and incentives
benefits.text: You may be eligible for funding towards installation. We stay current on the schemes and help you apply.

feature.title: Shown how it works, then supported for good
feature.text: Your installer walks you through the new charger before they leave, and we remain a call away long after — for any problem, big or small.

process.title: Book a consultation
process.text: A free, no-obligation conversation about your vehicles, your property and the right charger for both.

process.title: Expert installation
process.text: Certified technicians handle electrical connections, mounting and commissioning, all to local codes.

process.title: Continued support
process.text: A walkthrough at handover, then ongoing support and maintenance whenever you need it.

services.title: Even warmth, from the ground up.
services.standfirst: Low-temperature heat spread across the whole floor — comfortable, quiet and the natural partner for a heat pump.

heroImage.alt: Underfloor heating pipework laid before screed

services.intro: Pipework laid beneath the floor warms each room evenly, with no radiators on the walls and zoned control room by room.

benefits.title: Even, comfortable heat
benefits.text: Warmth rises gently across the whole room instead of from a single hot spot on the wall.

benefits.title: Lower running costs
benefits.text: Running at lower temperatures lets a heat pump work at its most efficient.

benefits.title: More usable space
benefits.text: With no radiators, walls are free for furniture, glazing and the way you want to live.

benefits.title: Room-by-room control
benefits.text: Zoned thermostats mean you only heat the rooms you are using.

feature.title: Planned into the floor build-up
feature.text: We design pipe layouts and zones around your floor plan and coordinate with your builder so the system goes in at the right stage.
